entries.name: GCC runtime (libgcc_s_dw2-1.dll)
entries.note: Licensed under the GNU GPL v3 with the GCC Runtime Library Exception; the exception allows it to accompany the app. Source: the MinGW32 (MSYS2) build of mdbtools from https://github.com/lsgunth/mdbtools-win, pinned to commit cefdd6d277b77a36f2073106c71ec84c65bece2d. Upstream: https://github.com/mdbtools/mdbtools. Windows build only. Full notice: tools/gs_importer/NOTICE.txt in the repository.
